violated_contract: A durable wake obligation must retire when its owner is deleted, merged away or leaves the live lifecycle. Terminal replay rows must not retain a due index that schedules no-op work forever.
canonical_prevention: Retire at every owning lifecycle commit through one shared transaction that rechecks the latest conversation and job. Preserve concurrently reopened live owners and generation-fence delivered workers. Remove terminal due indexes instead of rescheduling them. Restore an existing quiet obligation atomically when processing rolls back to an eligible live owner; fence pre-admission deliveries with a new generation.
